colophon.title: Colophon
colophon.description: How this site is built: Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS exported as static pages, Archivo and Doto type, and figures drawn with CSS and SVG in the browser.

sections.title: Stack
sections.text: Next.js with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, exported as static HTML and served from Cloudflare. Case studies are written in MDX.

sections.title: Type
sections.text: Archivo for text, with its width axis stretched for headlines. Doto for numbers.

sections.title: Figures
sections.text: The figures are drawn with CSS and SVG and run in the browser. The attention weights, the map's positions and similarity scores, and the trace's bar widths are set by hand to tell the story; they are not output from a real model or measured timings. The quote check runs a real matching function on example text. With reduced motion on, every figure shows its final state.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Privacy on this site: no cookies and no personal data. Cloudflare Web Analytics and Umami count visits anonymously; your theme choice stays on your device.

sections.title: No cookies, no personal data
sections.text: This site sets no cookies and collects no personal data. There are no forms and no accounts.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.text: Two cookieless tools count visits without identifying you. Cloudflare Web Analytics shows how many people visit and which pages they read. Umami counts a few actions, such as downloading the CV, copying the email address or reading a case study to the end, and which site or tagged link brought a visit. Neither stores personal data or follows you to other sites.

sections.title: Your theme choice
sections.text: If you switch between the light and dark theme, your choice is saved in your browser's localStorage so the site remembers it next time. It never leaves your device.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.text: The site is served by Cloudflare, which processes the technical data any web request needs, such as your IP address, to deliver the pages.
